correctness.rationale: The published sector determinants were reconstructed. Their common quadratic bracket factors identically into the two residual factors from sectors \(j=0\) and \(j=2\). The resulting scalar root sets are disjoint and avoid the elementary exact factors. Derivative arguments prove every scalar root simple; a simple determinant zero gives a one-dimensional kernel in each containing sector, so the orthogonal symmetry decomposition gives multiplicity exactly three. Local series expansions give the stated \(K_n^{-1}\) and \(L_n^{-2}\) offsets. The supplied verifier independently rechecks the coefficient identities and representative roots.

value.rationale: The source singles out the octahedron as the even-degree exceptional Platonic graph but leaves two infinite spectral families only in asymptotic intervals. Replacing those enclosures by exact scalar equations, exact triple degeneracy, and sharp leading offsets gives a structural spectral description of the exceptional model rather than a routine numerical refinement. It also explains why the same two branches recur across three symmetry sectors.
